vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained and unsafe by design. No fix available.

statements.impact_statement: The golang.org/x/crypto MODULE is a build dependency by two paths — filippo.io/age imports chacha20poly1305, hkdf, curve25519 and scrypt, and Wardyn imports golang.org/x/crypto/ssh directly for the SSH gateway. Neither pulls in the openpgp SUBPACKAGE, which is where the advisory lives. `go mod why golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp` reports 'main module does not need package golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp', and govulncheck's symbol-level analysis reports 'Your code is affected by 0 vulnerabilities' — GO-2026-5932 appears only in the module-level 'modules you require' tally, never in the call-graph-verified findings. govulncheck runs in CI on every push, so this stays true rather than being a one-time observation.
